paras: Liolaemus dorbignyi, commonly known as D'Orbigny's tree iguana, is a species of lizard in the family  Liolaemidae. The species is endemic to South America.
The specific name, dorbignyi, is in honor of French naturalist Alcide d'Orbigny.
L. dorbignyi is native to Argentina and Bolivia.
The preferred natural habitat of L. dorbignyi is grassland, at altitudes of 3,900–4,350 m (12,800–14,270 ft).
Large and heavy-bodies for its genus, L. dorbignyi may attain a snout-to-vent length (SVL) of almost 10 cm (almost 4 in).
